title: FREELAB v0.10.57 — Agency spatial UI and clean navigation
changes: Simplified Agency navigation and removed unused left-controller Experimental selector from My Stuff and shipped assets.
Enlarged Agency board and placed a subdued SELECT AN ACTIVITY prompt within the panel; icons are 80% of previous dimensions and secondary navigation shares one depth below the board.
Spread Throw targets across the upper room space at 30% of prior dimensions with low-cost star-field glow; wrong-colour hits remove the projectile immediately with a red particle cue.
Moved the AGENCY return control to the right periphery, separated the Number Flow answers, and placed semi-transparent timer and score indicators farther from the tabletop.
Restored private/public room selection before XR entry, retained depth request, and made camera and voice prompts closer and less intrusive.
Made Quest keyboard Enter/change/blur submit one question without requiring a second keypress.
Included an improved release watcher with a reasonable future archive budget while retaining strict SHA-256, unsafe-path, integrity and ZIP resource checks.
Preserved existing My Stuff data, private progress, headset graphics settings, and shared-server deployment safeguards.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.56 — Gentle Agency flow and colour labs
changes: Smooth scene crossfades with immediate input locking, a breathing gap after answers, two-hand collision prevention, and finger withdrawal before reactivation.
Preserve manually moved tabletop position when replaying; move the hand-icon MOVE handle to the far left and place mode/AGENCY controls on the right.
Put translucent large game headings and scores at greater depth, and include the signed-in profile name and optional private avatar photograph.
Require an explicit second selection to exit XR from the Agency lobby, reducing accidental exit.
Add colour-coded Throw Lab targets and no-timer matching scores, pastel fading target effects, new frame colours, and fresh clean rounds.
Add individually coloured falling cubes that stack or cancel in matching-colour pairs, distinct hanging frame colours, and correct/incorrect Shape Sort sparkles.
Keep experimental activities in Agency rather than My Stuff, preserve passthrough and private progress, and avoid new paid requests.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.55 — Agency XR navigation and gameplay rebuild
changes: Agency main navigation uses a wider, closer board with borderless, large activity icons and a single readable game name on hover.
World-space typography now retains original width-to-height proportions; icons gain an illuminated outline only on hover.
Agency navigation eases with head turns but stays still during forward movement and hand/controller interaction.
Shape Garden, Number Flow and Hand Harmony open directly and place their interactive elements closer to the hands with clear face-on labels.
MOVE handle lets the user relocate the activity layout; objects can be rotated during a grab, released or tossed, with distinct positive and corrective audio feedback.
Hand Harmony spawns smaller targets at varied reachable locations; game navigation uses AGENCY rather than My Stuff or misleading Finish links.
Experimental labs now render in a dedicated Agency session view without My Stuff UI or the left-controller experiment selector.
All existing private My Stuff captures, collections, AI providers and server data are preserved. Quest hardware acceptance remains necessary.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.55 — Agency board scale, hover and routing polish
changes: Widen Agency board, enlarge icon-first game targets and remove tiny under-icon captions.
Preserve the AGENCY heading and Play. Focus. Feel good. subtitle without stretching or compressing text.
Increase proximity/hover scaling and add dynamic icon focus borders with hover-based activity description.
Improve controller and hand ray visibility with soft pastel sampled gradients and brighter endpoints.
Keep experimental lab sessions under Agency navigation, with Home returning to Agency and My Stuff leaving the lab.
Retain the previous v0.10.53 board and existing private data and deployment protections.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.53 — XR entrance emphasis and unified Agency board
changes: Increase XR entrance hover motion so MY STUFF and AGENCY scale and float forward more clearly as the user approaches or points.
Add gentle procedural hover-out and choice sounds on the entrance, alongside the existing hover and selection cues.
Rebuild Agency as one unified curved board that mixes games and experimental labs together, following the supplied handwritten layout instead of separating sections.
Replace the previous floating experimental menu language with clean white outlined icon cards, consistent pill navigation and direct access back to MY STUFF.
Keep Agency setup and summary screens in the same white-outline design language for visual continuity.
Preserve private data, provider behavior and existing My Stuff / experimental functionality while refining the XR navigation flow.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.50 — premium spatial glass entrance
changes: Replace opaque, muddy entrance cards with transparent spatial surfaces, luminous thick white rounded borders and one vivid mint-cyan accent, keeping passthrough visible.
Create polished editorial typography layers with generous space, full-size titles, raised text parallax and responsive proximity, pointer hover and controller focus.
Add a quiet illustrated belongings motif and organic brain-line illustration within the entrance cards, without unrelated floating geometry or game primitives.
Keep both entrance panels gently yaw-following the headset with inertia and a dead zone, at close usable XR reach; retain angled panels and exact rotated hit testing for hands and controller rays.
Reuse the existing warm WebAudio entrance and selection jingles and restrained controller haptics; honor reduced-motion preferences.
Keep XR-first navigation, My Stuff collection tools and all existing Agency game logic, private user data and Nginx-safe watcher deployment unchanged.
Regression-test angled panel ray and finger hits, versioned assets, entrance interaction wiring and unchanged immersive navigation.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.49 — clean XR entrance cards
changes: Replace the entrance sculpture clusters, arches, trays and floor rings with exactly two large upright rectangular panels inside the immersive WebXR session, matching the supplied two-card reference.
Render MY STUFF and AGENCY titles and their short descriptions directly on high-contrast dark panels with quiet teal/violet neon edges; remove detached labels and decorative shapes from the entrance.
Place both panels at a more comfortable headset viewing distance; preserve passthrough outside the panels and retain XR-first navigation with no browser choice.
Make the full visible rectangle the controller-ray, pinch and fingertip hit target; prevent selection when pointing or touching outside a card.
Keep the existing My Stuff collection, spatial capture, reconstruction, Agency activities, user data, backend and isolated shared-Nginx deployment safeguards unchanged.
Add regression coverage for the two-panel entrance and real hit-testing of both rectangles without any live headset or paid provider request.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.48 — immersive XR entrance and spatial Agency
changes: Enter XR directly from the browser and choose MY STUFF or AGENCY only inside the immersive WebXR scene; preserve My Stuff camera, collections, capture and models.
Replace Agency 2D rectangles with native perspective-lit 3D portal sculptures, animated shapes, neon open-top sorting bins, tactile number choices and a spatial L/R hand target.
Restore the in-headset Home route from both My Stuff toolbar and Agency, with hand-pinch, direct fingertip touch, and controller ray/trigger selection.
Keep Free Play, 120-second Timed, daily deterministic challenges, four difficulty levels and browser-local private progress, with gentle response feedback and no medical claims.
Remove the browser My Stuff/Agency gate and standalone 2D Agency UI; browser remains the XR launch and collection administration surface.
Preserve active shared Nginx configuration on updates, with a compatibility preflight and no shared-service reload; keep watcher v0.9.2 and all existing service/data boundaries.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.47 — macOS room thumbnail validation compatibility
changes: Resolve the room image storage root before security containment checks, avoiding false-negative thumbnails on macOS where /var resolves to /private/var.
Apply the same canonical-path verification in the authenticated room thumbnail endpoint and card metadata; retain rejection of image symlinks that escape private storage.
Add symlink-based cross-platform regression coverage for accepted private-room access and for attempted media directory escapes.
Preserve enhanced room cards, activity history, existing rooms and all previous 3D/XR features without reprocessing assets or making paid provider calls.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.45 — spatial room cards, previews and session analytics
changes: Spatial Rooms now use image-backed desktop cards, with a privacy-safe patterned backdrop when no image has been shared to a room.
Room cards display live/offline status, public/private visibility, current participants, shared image count, last active time, session count, last session length and cumulative visit time.
New All rooms / Live / My rooms filters, live-first/recent, most-sessions and alphabetical sorting, plus manual refresh and 30-second lobby refresh.

SQLite now tracks host and guest room sessions from existing XR publishing and desktop presence heartbeats, deduplicating polls and ending abandoned sessions at the last heartbeat. Historical visits are not invented.
Room thumbnails are resized server-side from pictures deliberately published into a room, with signed-in access, private-room membership enforcement, path checks and no-store caching.
Existing rooms, images, 3D assets, XR interactions and private account data are preserved. No paid provider calls are introduced.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.44 — stable first-open desktop 3D aspect ratio
changes: Desktop 3D viewer now sizes its WebGL drawing buffer from the visible viewer viewport instead of stale canvas client dimensions; this fixes squashed models that only recovered after manually resizing the browser.
Model viewer viewport and WebGL canvas have independent layout sizing so the canvas intrinsic pixel dimensions cannot cause a grid feedback loop on first open.
Camera aspect and pixel ratio update on initial open, completed model loading, layout changes, and fullscreen/DevTools resizing using a ResizeObserver and guarded frame checks.
Regression tests exercise initial dimensions, successive resizes, hidden or temporarily zero-height layout and re-opening, without modifying imported GLB geometry.
Saved avatars, Tripo/AHOLO models, Quest rendering and paid provider settings remain unchanged.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.42 — direct XR grabbing and linked media archive
changes: Desktop 3D viewer corrects tall GLB presentation by orienting Z-up geometry in a separate display-only pivot, preserving native axis proportions and removing the near top-down camera fit.
Private Collection now offers All Media, Images and 3D Models filters; generated models appear beside related images with provider identification, preview thumbnails and clickable source links.
Quest replaces intrusive model axis gizmos with direct controller/hand drag-and-turn; a second hand scales proportionally, and one small reset button remains headset-relative.
3D jobs from Tripo and AHOLO are presented as distinct source-related spatial branches, including jobs created from edited images, without submitting new paid generation.
Quest cinematic preview includes source and saved descendants not presently visible on the active tree page, so previous/next navigate the full local image chain.
Preserves saved models, textures, transforms and private library records; no database migration or new paid generation is performed.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.41 — 3D texture and proportion fixes
changes: Protect per-triangle GLB UV coordinates when simplifying dense Quest geometry: welding positions no longer overwrites UV seams and texture-atlas mappings.
Respect glTF base-colour texture coordinate set and KHR_texture_transform, with safe solid-material fallback when the selected UV channel is unavailable.
Previously cached XR geometry made with the old texture-mapping logic is rebuilt once from the saved private GLB; this is not another paid Tripo generation.
Desktop 3D viewer now centres GLB scenes with a separate uniform-scale pivot and uses the broad face for thin/flat objects, avoiding apparently squashed edge-on previews.
Preserve existing source-linked XR model placement, transform controls and original GLB assets.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.39 — spatial XR model gizmos and library crash fix
changes: Fixes the XR library crash caused by a static library heading entering the Bezier animation with undefined endpoints. Library pagination and returning to collection no longer break the render loop.
Select an existing generated 3D model in Quest to reveal spatial red X, green Y and blue Z transform gizmos, plus a compact MOVE / ROTATE / SCALE toolbar.
Grab and drag a coloured axis to move a model along that axis; ROTATE exposes three oriented rings for rotating around each local axis.
SCALE adjusts X, Y and Z independently with coloured handles; controller grabbing, wrist twist and two-hand uniform scaling are still supported.
Model position, quaternion rotation, uniform size and independent X/Y/Z scale are stored privately with the existing 3D job and restored when reopened.
Transforms use the existing FREELAB WebGL XR renderer without adding a competing Three.js render loop. No additional paid 3D generation is required.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.38 — XR models now retain GPU parts; faster diagnostics and clearer library
changes: Fixes the exact Quest MODEL_DRAW_SKIPPED parts:0 bug: previously the scene model referenced the same array used for temporary upload cleanup; clearing the temporary array also erased every drawable mesh. The model now takes its own array of GPU parts and releases them only on collection closure.
Adds MODEL_RENDER_PARTS_COMMITTED with the retained buffer count, and preserves MODEL_FIRST_GPU_DRAW_SUBMITTED for a real rendering confirmation.

Removes expensive periodic GPU framebuffer queries and repetitive browser console/status traces by default. Explicit debug mode can enable infrequent diagnostics using window.FreeLabXR3DDiagnostics.setVerbose(true).
Reduces full 3D job rescan frequency while retaining asynchronous job polling and automatic model placement.
XR Library shows a permanent page header, newest-first order, item count, page number, dated thumbnails, and NEWER/OLDER navigation. Selecting a thumbnail opens its saved source.
The existing private 3D thumbnail gallery, downloadable original models and Quest-compatible previews remain intact; no paid provider call is introduced by this repair.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.35 — Tripo completion-to-XR delivery recovery
changes: New Tripo generation jobs are now followed by a bounded server-side monitor that saves completed GLBs immediately; headset and collection polling are not required to start private download before signed provider links expire.
On return to Collection after a Gunicorn restart, outstanding jobs resume provider status monitoring without any new paid generation request.
Quest XR cycles status checks across all pending 3D jobs, prioritizing the newest job; older stalled jobs cannot starve new jobs of updates.
A downloaded GLB is accepted from cache only if its file header and declared size are valid; interrupted cache files are replaced on the next authenticated provider fetch.
Quest model upload explicitly rejects lost WebGL contexts or failed GPU allocations rather than falsely reporting a model as attached.
Models remain source-linked and the existing compact 3D progress cube is retained; no floating diagnostics panel or extra paid task is introduced.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.34 — 3D presets, model transforms and textured preview recovery
changes: XR-ready, Balanced and High-detail Tripo image-to-3D presets select a real P2 or H3.1 model version and triangle limit before submitting a paid task.
Tripo texture fidelity (Standard, Detailed, Extreme/8K) is independently selectable, with a separate 512/1024/2048-pixel Quest preview texture cap; generation parameters are preserved per model job.

Quest 3D meshes have spatial hit targets and can be grabbed with controllers or tracked-hand pinches, moved, rotated with wrist/controller twist and scaled with two hands; a compact minus/rotate/plus toolbar provides alternative controls.
Model transforms are validated and stored privately relative to their source photograph; reopening the collection restores placement without another paid model generation.
XR 3D progress badges now distinguish download, optimization, decoding and attachment stages; completed textured geometry replaces the source-linked cube.
Desktop/mobile 3D viewer now reads the actual textured parts response, waits through asynchronous server preparation and accepts the same source-linked models, without another generation request.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.33 — XR 3D preparation recovery and theater transforms
changes: Cinematic Previous, Next and Close now share the exact same world-space transform and follow the photograph’s rotation; one evenly spaced row sits below its bottom edge, outside the image.
Generated GLBs up to 64 MB can be cached privately; large and dense models are converted to a bounded Quest preview using Blender without altering the original or submitting a second paid task.

The Quest preview worker maintains a heartbeat so interrupted server workers no longer leave 3D generation permanently stuck on Preparing, and short preparation stages update the existing cube status.
XR image-to-model previews throttle their own retry requests while the server prepares a model; retry and failure recovery remain available without paid regeneration.
Tests cover the real theater coordinate-system bug, original vs preview size limits, bounded worker recovery, and source-linked model processing.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.32 — Quest performance and 3D recovery
changes: Tripo/AHOLO/Meshy provider status checks are now scheduled in bounded background workers instead of holding XR API requests open.
Signed GLB retrieval, private caching, Quest geometry decoding, and optional Blender preparation are asynchronous, with a private cached geometry response and no second paid generation.
Quest 3D preview responds with preparing/waiting until model bytes are ready; a permanent failure is returned once, and the user can explicitly retry the original task.
XR shared-room publishing slows to a safe rate and backs off after gateway failures; unexpected HTML responses produce a clear connection status instead of a JSON parse exception.
The existing spatial source/3D attachment and quiet error badge are retained; no extra floating diagnostics window is introduced.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.31 — Tripo result recovery and uncluttered XR
changes: Tripo v3 output handling accepts model_url, PBR, base model and nested legacy variants, including URL object forms; textured output is preferred.
Completed Tripo jobs recover their GLB through the original task ID and refresh short-lived signed URLs without starting or billing another generation task.
Private model downloads accept provider-authenticated HTTPS object-storage URLs with DNS/redirect safety checks, retain the 32 MB GLB cap and cache validated models locally.
Quest XR no longer opens a floating server-diagnostics panel when a model fails to load; the source-linked red cube and existing status UI report a concise retry action.
Existing paid jobs and profiles are preserved. Detailed pipeline reports remain available through the explicitly opened LOG/Collection diagnostics only.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.30 — 3D model pipeline diagnostics and recovery
changes: Read-only 3D pipeline inspection shows generation, output URL eligibility, local GLB size and compression, Blender conversion, Quest geometry and placement stages.
Tap an XR 3D job cube for a larger readable diagnosis. A second tap on a failed preview retries preparation using the existing generated model without billing.
Collection adds per-job Inspect 3D pipeline and Retry XR preview controls.
Tripo new jobs store the exact H3.1 version identifier; existing jobs without a stored version are marked unknown instead of guessed.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.29 — Spatial 3D generation cubes and automatic XR model preparation
changes: Every 3D generation task now appears as a small source-attached 3D cube with gently animated cyan, violet and pink gradient faces and illuminated edges.
Failed tasks and 3D preview failures turn the cube red with short error labels. The cube disappears when a finished textured model is placed in XR.

Previously generated private GLBs are loaded automatically from the saved source. When Quest cannot decode compressed or dense geometry, a bounded server-side Blender preparation job can convert a private XR preview in the background.
The UI retries read-only preview preparation without submitting or charging another generative AI request. Completed models remain attached to their original source and disappear with it.
The existing full-quality GLB is preserved, while converted XR previews are stored separately and protected by the same authenticated job ownership checks.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.28 — Stationary theater controls at image bottom
changes: XR theater now displays three matching white circular controls in a single stationary left, right, close row directly along the image bottom edge.
Controls are anchored to the image surface instead of the headset; turning or moving the head no longer relocates or rotates their positions.
When the image loads with its true aspect ratio, the control row adjusts once to the final image geometry and stays in position.
Previous, next and close actions remain on the same XR controller ray interactions; no changes to paid provider operations or saved collections.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.27 — Source-linked 3D pop-in and job visibility
changes: Each XR 3D generation request now creates a visible spatial job branch anchored to the selected source or segment, showing provider and task progress while generation runs in the background.
Completed textured GLBs pop outward beside the source with spatial particles and a connecting lineage line; they remain attached when the parent image is moved.

Quest refreshes active-source job states asynchronously, including tasks submitted from another device. Reopening a source restores up to six XR model previews instead of silently limiting recovery to two.
When focused deeper in a branch, source-level models can attach to the visible ancestor source thumbnail instead of disappearing because the main source card is hidden.

Provider task failures and unsupported model previews appear as explicit, source-linked spatial status cards. Models still remain saved in Collection and no extra generation charges are triggered by previews.
Closing or collapsing a source releases its temporary model meshes, status cards, buffers and textures. Quest device-level verification remains necessary.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.26 — Tripo generation and Draco GLBs
changes: Tripo v3 image-to-model generation now works with private image uploads and asynchronous job status, using the same source-linked collection as AHOLO and Meshy.
Tripo Test now calls the read-only account balance API and checks real authentication and credits without generating or billing a model.
Choose AHOLO, Meshy or Tripo from desktop/mobile Settings, the capture composer or the XR configuration panel; the preference follows the profile.
The browser 3D viewer now configures a Three.js Draco loader for Draco-compressed avatars and generated GLB files.
XR refreshes the active source’s completed model previews periodically so jobs submitted on another device can appear beside their source image.
Existing profile settings remain compatible through a non-destructive SQLite provider-choice extension.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.25 — XR voice, text creation and avatar optimization
changes: Profile 3D avatar size limit increased to 4 MB. Files up to 16 MB can be inspected locally and optionally submitted to a separate opt-in Blender optimizer targeting 4 MB.

Private headless Blender optimization jobs are bounded, stored with owner-scoped read-only status, and never replace a working avatar unless a valid GLB under 4 MB is produced. Server-side Blender must be installed.
Avatar preview shows the selected GLB locally even above the XR upload limit, including exact file size and the reduction needed.
XR listening controls and transcripts follow the head near the middle of the view; transcripts use significantly larger type and are placed beside the microphone.

XR keyboard Enter submits the instruction without requiring another editor action. Recognized voice commands and image prompts send automatically unless the new voice-confirmation preference is enabled.
Text-only Muse Image generation creates a saved source without a camera or existing source. CREATE is available in XR; desktop/mobile message composer also supports text-only creation.
Theater previous, next, and exit controls are grouped together in one head-relative row, with the caption size increased for XR source/object cards.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.24 — Textured XR models linked to source captures
changes: XR-generated models now use a bounded texture-aware GLB decoder that preserves embedded base-colour images, material colour, UVs and scene-node transforms.

Dense generated meshes are simplified by spatial vertex clustering instead of skipping faces that appeared as disjoint green star fragments; geometry that cannot be simplified coherently produces a clear fallback message.
3D previews are normalised and displayed at a compact ~30 cm largest-axis scale beside their parent source or object, moving with the source card.
Completed models are retrieved read-only from the source-linked job history when the source is reopened; no paid job is re-submitted.
Closing, hiding, binning or navigating away from a capture removes linked model geometry and textures from the active XR scene; the 3D job and full original GLB remain saved in Collection.
Existing static guest-avatar previews and desktop full-GLB viewer remain available. Headset renderer performance and unusual GLB formats require Quest verification.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.23 — Upright framed photos, bounded crop and spatial grab
changes: Fixed upside-down FRAME photograph textures with correct top-to-bottom UV mapping for browser-camera images.

Frame photos now crop a live browser-camera JPEG using the hand-drawn rectangle projected through WebXR viewer matrices, with an aspect-preserving bounded crop, rather than stretching the whole camera image.
The projection approximates the selected field of view; a separate browser camera is not calibrated to Quest passthrough and cannot supply pixel-perfect crops.
Pinching anywhere inside or near the filled spatial photo now grabs and moves/rotates its linked frame; releasing pins the photograph at the new pose.
Erasing or expiring a frame now discards its attached photo and GPU texture/buffer; up to 12 image panels remain resident.
Normal XR eye capture still saves an independent full camera frame and selected image state is not overwritten by rectangle photo captures.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.22 — Inline editing, live models and spatial camera frames
changes: Send in Capture Studio now edits or refines the selected image directly; no second text-entry modal. The gallery has its own inline editor.
3D jobs are monitored globally when the site is visible, with distinct queued/running/completed/failed states. Completed GLBs load into an interactive private Three.js scene with geometry fallback.
Private model cache limit raised from 12 to 32 MB with SHA/GLB checks, size cap, provider URL allowlist and authenticated access. Models above the new limit still depend on the provider link.

Profiles accept self-contained GLB avatars under 2 MB; XR guests and browser-room spectators receive static decimated 3D avatar previews where supported. Rigging is preserved in storage; no body-pose streaming yet.
Desktop and mobile capture/gallery/collection menus include Download photo. The three XR roundels move higher, the LIB/PIN/LOG bar lower and cinema controls form a compact grouped row.

Placing an experimental FRAME saves a photo only if a separately permissioned, readable browser camera stream exists; it maps the snapshot on the frame. Standard Quest XR passthrough framebuffer pixels cannot be captured.
Watcher v0.9.2 uses NUL-delimited Git status so allowed update ZIP filenames containing spaces do not falsely block preflight.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.22 — Watcher-safe release identity
changes: Repackaged the v0.10.20 UX hotfix under a unique v0.10.22 release identity so the watcher can pick it up.
Retains the refine/extract separation, bottom image editor, asynchronous 3D task UI, gradient feedback and XR/theater layout changes.
No provider configuration, database reset, watcher replacement or paid API operation is introduced.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.20 — Refine flow, spatial controls and packaging repair
changes: Refine image now opens a multiline image-quality editor rather than asking for an object to segment; named-object extraction remains a separate command.
Bottom-aligned image editor keeps the original photo visible. Removed redundant instructions and added animated rainbow text during processing.
3D tasks remain asynchronous; clearer queued-status messages explain users can continue working while the model is generated.
XR navigation now sits lower beneath the capture roundels; microphone icons and captions are adjusted for headset legibility.
Desktop room fullscreen groups previous, next and close controls. Cards use larger captions.
Deployment ZIP excludes Python bytecode and test caches; release manifest lists only application source files.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.19 — Unified AI controls & reliable 3D
changes: Desktop/mobile and gallery now use one in-page confirmation/entry overlay; no browser-native confirm, prompt or alert dialogs for AI and account actions.

Capture actions reuse three roundels (microphone, describe, extract) over selected photo, with extra tools including 3D under a contextual three-dot menu; a second shutter row is hidden while inspecting.

Multiline, expandable instruction composer supports image edits, questions, extraction, targeted segment refinement and image-guided 3D prompt submissions. The microphone uses an actual microphone icon.
Live AI requests show an animated active border and progress chip, keeping results below the photo rather than disappearing in notifications.
Read-only saved-description history is restored to capture and gallery views without new paid inference calls.
3D connection check distinguishes configured provider key from a successful generation and shows recent job states without charging credits. Paid submissions require explicit confirmation.
AHOLO Lux3D receives encoded JPEG pixels directly instead of a temporary private image URL; creative prompts select its text-to-3D route with an optional reference image, not silently ignored.

3D status checks display real provider state and error text, with polling only while the capture view is open. Completed GLBs are downloaded into a 12 MB bounded private server cache when the provider download host is allowlisted; owners can retrieve saved assets after link expiry.
Audio recording uses AudioWorkletNode when available, with legacy ScriptProcessor fallback only for older browsers.
XR capture roundels moved slightly lower to reduce panel overlap. Live AHOLO billing, task success and Quest positioning require production/device verification.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.18 — Quest renderer and compact capture experience
changes: Quest immersive AR now prefers WebGL2, uses an XRWebGLLayer without unsupported DOM overlay, reduces compositor framebuffer scale and stops GPU work after context loss. Landing Three.js renderer is disabled in Quest Browser to prevent competing contexts.
Mobile browsers without immersive-ar support show ENTER 3D; launch an interactive private Three.js spatial preview of existing sources and branches (not a claim of AR passthrough).
Development log uses shorter copy, compact scroll window, round borderless close button and smaller release typography.
Top navigation pills use consistent desktop heights and spacing and reduce on narrow screens.
Camera studio distinguishes live video from an inspected image. Selected source or segment shows overlaid Voice, Describe and Extract controls; library is toggled, not required to use AI.
More menu contains full advanced camera, extraction quality, named segmentation, manual save and optional sampling controls without a separate legacy-controls section.
Image instruction composer supports prompt edits, descriptions, extraction, refined segmentation, 3D generation and voice. Provider calls remain explicit and billable work requires confirmation.
Collection uses image-first thumbnails, name/date overlays, a 3-dot per-object contextual menu and live filtering by label, date, description and metadata.
Full-screen gallery fills the available viewport, has compact white circular side arrows, mobile swipe navigation and a contextual menu for image AI actions.
Live Quest rendering and all webcam/AI combinations still require device verification; fallback never fabricates readable passthrough camera pixels.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.17 — XR controls, collaboration and profile management
changes: Development log now shows current release and scrollable previous release history.
Settings profile photo uses a clickable circular upload control, with upload or camera choice supported by the device.
Administrators can list users, reset passwords, temporarily block/unblock accounts, and remove non-admin users; sensitive changes revoke sessions.
XR image labels render only once in the viewer-sized caption (white); card action labels turn pink on hover.
Theater navigation buttons form a near-eye bottom row with white background and dark symbols.
Lower and shrink voice transcript and confirmation controls; move capture roundels away from game actions; reposition description panel and billboard config panel.
Mascot speech is stopped when hidden; contextual comments have larger variety, per-phrase repetition cooldown and audio overlap protection.
Voice search highlights and temporarily brings forward matching saved segments. Global restyle commands ask for second confirmation and cap edits to six billed images.
New optional XR depth entry requests depth-sensing before session begins, checks enabledFeatures correctly and reports sensor availability without claiming occlusion.
Joined spectators appear as named room-presence badges in host XR, and optional experimental frame outlines are shared to desktop room viewers (off by default).
Provider API test remains separate from asynchronous AHOLO Lux3D creation, polling and result retrieval.
WebRTC audio/video, physical passthrough rectangle screenshots and texture bin require additional permissions, signaling and calibration; not claimed as available in this release.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.16 — Active nginx virtual host repair
changes: Fix ES module MIME on the nginx vhost that is actually loaded, even if sites-available differs from sites-enabled
Add active-vhost discovery and safe refusal for multiple or unrelated virtual hosts
Back up and roll back both nginx config files when live and canonical locations differ
Make room-viewer.mjs and scene.mjs explicit application/javascript locations and verify via real HTTPS before completing
Retain the v0.10.15 desktop rooms, mobile capture studio, XR accessibility and brand updates

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.15 — Server-layout deployment fix
changes: Correct deployment test to work without the repository-root watcher in Ubuntu release directories
Preserve v0.10.14 desktop room, mobile capture, XR typography and branding improvements
Keep nginx JavaScript MIME verification and rollback protection for ES modules

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.14 — Spatial rooms & capture studio
changes: Fix nginx MIME for all ES modules; pre-deploy check catches broken room viewer
Spatial room captions use fixed CSS text size with clickable branches and live FPS display
Mobile capture studio: source photography, image tree, voice, refine, describe, edit and 3D actions
XR menus: white text by default, pastel pink on hover; borderless theatrical fullscreen
Pastel animated brand, private profile picture, subtle mascot particles, updated footer

history.title: Three.js Spatial Rooms · v0.10.13
changes: Replaced the canvas-based room mockup with a fullscreen, continuously rendered Three.js spatial viewer
Added fluid orbit/zoom with pointer inertia, Fit Scene, and free-flight exploration with WASD, Q/E and Shift
Spectators see a tracked headset avatar with live head orientation, actual 3D image planes and parent-child branch links
Click a floating image to inspect the full media, saved description, ancestor or child links, and enlarge it
The room feed now includes authenticated metadata and headset/card orientations; camera pixels are never streamed
XR room publishing and desktop state polling run multiple times per second; Three.js rendering is independent of polling
Room UI and gallery fill the viewport and do not alter the private-by-default invitation model or archive data
